ImageDescription.value:
2012 London Olympics

In celebration of ‘All Eyes On Korea>’ a 100 Day Festival of Korean Culture, the Korean Cultural Centre UK (KCCUK) in collaboration with the Victoria and Albert Museum presented ‘Korea Shining Bright’ a Gala Reception hosted by the Korean Minister for Culture, Sport and Tourism, Choe Kwang-shik.

The Minister’s Reception took place in the iconic Raphael Gallery of the Victoria and Albert Museum on Monday 30 July 2012, 8pm. Featuring two Catwalk fashion show presentations of 60 outfits by leading Asian Designer and V&A Exhibitor Lie Sang Bong the reception was also complimented by a Korean Food Demonstration and Dinner. Three hundred guests attended this exclusive event, including British and international government officials, cultural figures, Olympic Committee members and other high profile guests.
